quests.requirements: Malboro Vine, Zinc Ore, Insect Wing
interactions: After speaking with Abeaule head over to Southern San d'Oria (G-6) and speak with Amaura.
Deliver the medicine to Abeaule for your reward.

quests.title: The Trader in the Forest
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Start this quest by speaking to Abeaule. He needs someone to fill an order for him. Accept this task and he will give you a Supplies Order .

Next: Take the Supplies Order to the tower at (I-11) in West Ronfaure and trade them to Phairet. You will receive the batagreens. Trading him 50 gil will also get you the batagreens as long as the quest has been flagged.
Take the batagreens back to Abeaule for your reward.

quests.title: The Vicasque's Sermon
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Talk to Abioleget, who needs you to deliver Blue Peas.
After giving him the peas, return to Abioleget for your reward.

name: Adeben
locations: Open Sea Route To Al Zahbi
zones: Open Sea Route To Al Zahbi

quests.title: The Stars of Ifrit
interactions: If you fulfill all the prerequisites of the quest, then speak to Agapito to begin quest.
Return to Agapito to complete the quest.

quests.title: A Boy's Dream
quests.requirements: Giant Shell Bug Odontotyrannus [Key Item] Knight's boots
interactions: Speak with Ailbeche.
Return to and speak with Ailbeche again.
Trade Ailbeche a Giant Shell Bug . Either buy one off the Auction House, or go to Crawler's Nest and defeat Dreadbug via the ??? on map 2, SW of H-9.
You can fish up Odontotyrannus (Monster) before trading Ailbeche the Giant Shell Bug in the previous step.
Return Ailbeche and trade them the Odontotyrannus .

quests.title: Father and Son
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Talk to Ailbeche to start the quest for a cutscene.
Ailbeche's father, Exoroche, can be found in Southern San d'Oria at (K-7) in Helbort's Blade.

Return to Ailbeche and talk to him again for a cutscene. You'll receive the willow fishing rod as reward. In order to active the Paladin AF1 quest, Sharpening the Sword, it's necessary to trade back the fishing rod to Ailbeche. Doing so will also change your title to Family Counselor.

quests.title: Sharpening the Sword
interactions: In order to start this quest, it's necessary to trade back the fishing rod to Ailbeche from the previous quest Father and Son.
Speak with Ailbeche near Home Point #2 to begin the quest. He will ask you for an Ordelle whetstone.
Return to Ailbeche to end the quest and receive your reward.

quests.title: Under Oath
quests.requirements: Zvahl Coffer Key [Key Item] Mique's paintbrush [Key Item] Strange sheet of paper
interactions: Speak to Ailbeche, Northern San d'Oria (J-9).
You may additionally talk to Ailbeche, Exoroche, and Vemalpeau for more quest-related dialogue. Vemalpeau will take your Knight's confession key item.

quests.title: Lure of the Wildcat (Bastok)
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak with Alib-Mufalib to recieve a Blue Sentinel badge and begin the quest.
Once you have spoken to all 20 people, return to Alib-Mufalib. He will take your Blue Sentinel badge and give you a Blue invitation card.

quests.title: The Postman Always K.O.'s Twice
quests.requirements: Damp Envelope Muddy Bar Tab Odd Postcard Torn Epistle
interactions: Speak to Ambrosius to begin this quest.
Trade Ambrosius one or all of the following: Muddy Bar Tab drops off of Savanna Rarab in East Sarutabaruta.

quests.title: Lure of the Wildcat (San d'Oria)
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak with Amutiyaal to recieve a [Key Item] Red Sentinel badge and begin the quest.
Once you have spoken to all 20 people, return to Amutiyaal. He will take your [Key Item] Red Sentinel badge and give you a [Key Item] Red invitation card.

quests.title: Grave Concerns
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Andecia (located in the middle house on the first floor of Squire's Alley) once to trigger story text. Speak to Andecia again after the first set of text to receive the Well Water item (will be deposited into your inventory).
Next: Travel to King Ranperre's Tomb (I-10) on the first map.
Return to Andecia and trade her Tomb Waterskin to complete quest.

quests.title: A Pose by Any Other Name
quests.requirements: Bronze Harness Leather Vest Robe Tunic Kenpogi
interactions: Speak to Angelica (F-10)
Talk to Angelica and stand still for 10 seconds.
Talk to Angelica again. Now she tells you to wear your item.
Talk to her the last time, and you've completed the quest. You will receive Ancient Blood and [Key Item] Angelica's autograph.
Next: If you refuse to model and/or you take too long to get the right body armor, you get the title "Lower than the Lowest Tunnel Worm" instead of "Supermodel"

quests.title: A Taste for Meat
interactions: Talk to Antreneau, then Thierride. They are both located in the Rusty Anchor Pub (@ G-7 in Port San d'Oria), to begin the quest.
Afterwards, Antreneau will give you a Grilled Hare if you speak with him.

quests.title: Over the Hills and Far Away
interactions: Speak to Antreneau, Port San d'Oria (G-7) to flag the quest.

quests.title: Can Cardians Cry?
interactions: Speak to Apururu to begin this quest. There is no need to zone after completing the previous quest.
Trade the Bruised Starfruit to Apururu for your reward.
Trading a Bruised Starfruit to Apururu after completing this quest will reward you with 1,000 gil. It is unknown if this is infinitely repeatable.

quests.title: Wild Card
interactions: If you spoke to Apururu, return to the Manustery in Windurst Woods (use Home Point #3).

quests.title: A Flash in the Pan
interactions: Talk to Aquillina in Bastok Markets at (K-9), she will ask for Flint Stones

Trade Flint Stone x4 to Aquillina to complete quest. Quest is repeatable but has a restriction of 15 earth minutes. This restriction is for everyone, not just yourself. So if another player has completed the quest recently, it will not be available.

quests.title: Stamp Hunt
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Arawn to start quest. You will be given the [Key Item] Stamp sheet to collect stamps.
Speak to Arawn again once you have collected all the stamps to complete the quest.

quests.title: Atelloune's Lament
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Atelloune in Southern San d'Oria at (L-6) for a cutscene to start the quest.

quests.title: Exit the Gambler
interactions: Start the quest by talking to Aurege (F-3) near Northern San d'Oria Home Point #4, outside of the Carpenter's Guild.
After winning, return and talk to Aurege for your reward.

quests.title: A Question of Faith
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Talk to Ayame for a cut-scene that starts the quest.

quests.title: Faded Promises
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Next speak with Ayame at (K-7) in the other Cannonry.
After that speak with Ayame again.

quests.title: Out of the Depths
interactions: Talk to Ayame for a starting cut-scene, agree twice to start the quest.

quests.title: Return to the Depths
interactions: Talk to Ayame for a cut-scene that starts the quest.
Return to Metalworks and talk with Ayame for the Bowyer Ring reward, and to end the quest.

quests.title: True Strength
interactions: Talk to Ayame in the Metalworks at (K-7). If you have finished the Treasures of Aht Urhgan Missions, you may need to speak with her twice.
Note: Once you have talked to Ayame, the quest will show up in your quest log, at this point you may switch to another job to complete the quest.
Trade the feather to Ayame for your Temple Hose .

quests.title: A Knight's Test
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Balasiel, who will give you the Book of Tasks containing hints on how to proceed.
Next: Speak to Cahaurme (J-9) from (L-8) (In the "Tower" above the East Gate) to recieve Book of the East.
Return to Balasiel to complete the quest.

quests.title: A Squire's Test II
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Balasiel to start the quest.
Speak to Balasiel to complete the quest.

quests.title: A Squire's Test
interactions: Talk to Balasiel, who asks of you a revival tree root.

quests.title: Knight Stalker
quests.requirements: Kuftal Coffer Key [Key Item] Challenge to the Royal Knights
interactions: Speak to Balasiel, Southern San d'Oria (F-7)

quests.title: Methods Create Madness
interactions: Speaking with Balasiel at (F-7) will grant you the key item Weapons Training Guide as well as the Spear of Trials. You will need to break the latent on the Spear of Trials before completing the rest of the quest.
Trade the Spear of Trials back to Balasiel. This will give you the key item Map to the Annals of Truth. You will be instructed to travel to Sea Serpent Grotto.
Next: Take Silent Oil with you and head to Sea Serpent Grotto. Make sure either you or someone in your party has a Sahagin Key .
Go back and speak with Balasiel to receive your reward.

quests.title: Stardust
interactions: Speak with Baldric inside the Darksteel Forge on the first floor to begin the quest.
Return to Baldric and trade him the sunsand to complete quest.

quests.title: A Feather in One's Cap
interactions: Baren-Moren asks you to get him three Giant Bird Feathers.

quests.title: All at Sea
interactions: Go to Baren-Moren in Windurst Waters South (H-7) and trade the Ripped Cap to him.
Baren-Moren requires 4 Dhalmel Hides to fix the cap.

quests.title: Hat in Hand
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Baren-Moren (H-7) to begin the quest and get the New model hat.
After you have shown the hat to the eight mandatory NPCs and 12 additional NPCs (i.e. 20 total), speak to Baren-Moren again to hang-up the hat which completes the quest.

quests.title: Trouble at the Sluice
interactions: Speak to Belgidiveau to begin the quest.
Return to Belgidiveau to complete this quest.

quests.title: The Wisdom of Elders
interactions: Speak with Benita to begin quest.
Trade Bomb Ash to Benita to complete quest.

quests.title: Drachenfall
interactions: Speak with Black Mud to begin quest. You will obtain a Brass Canteen .
Next: Travel to Dangruf Wadi and head north from the entrance. The quickest method is via Survival Guide, otherwise zone in from South Gustaberg (D-9).
Return to Bastok and trade water to Black Mud to complete the quest.

quests.title: Brygid the Stylist Returns
interactions: Speak to Brygid on any job while wearing any 1 to 5 pieces of Artifact Armor to begin the quest. Note: Artifact Armor +1 and Reforged Artifact Armor will not work. You must use non-enhanced/original Artifact Armor.

quests.title: Brygid the Stylist
interactions: Talk to Brygid the Fashion Police in Bastok Markets at (K-9), and she'll tell you how much your fashion sense sucks!
Complete this quest to later unlock Brygid the Stylist Returns.

quests.title: Carbuncle Debacle
quests.requirements: Ltng. Pendulum [Key Item] Daze-breaker charm Wind Pendulum
interactions: You must zone after completing the previous quest.

quests.title: Class Reunion
interactions: While your main job is Summoner, interact with the House of the Hero in Windurst Walls for a cutscene with Carbuncle. He will give you a [Key Item] Carbuncle's Tear.

Next: Speak to Koru-Moru in Windurst Walls at (E-7). He will ask for four Astragaloi. Astragalos may be purchased at the Bonecrafting Guild in Windurst Woods from Shih Tayuun, but is only restocked if players NPC it to the guild.

quests.title: I Can Hear a Rainbow
interactions: Obtain a Carbuncle's Ruby from a Leech mob. Poison Leeches in Buburimu Peninsula are possibly the easiest ones to drop Rubies.

Next: Alternatively, Bloodsuckers in Toraimarai Canal may have the highest drop rate. However, the area is difficult to get to for newer players, and there are only two spawns - at H-9 and J-9 on Map 1.

You will be instructed to experience 7 types of weather in outdoor areas. It seems only zones available in or before the Rise of Zilart Expansion will work. Note: The Carbuncle's Ruby must be in your inventory to receive the weather cutscene. You also can't simply idle in a zone - you must zone into an area while the weather is occuring to get the scene.
Next: Western / Eastern Altepa Desert (Rare, available all year)
If you drop Carbuncle's Ruby before completing the quest, you do NOT lose progress; simply obtain another one.

quests.title: The Puppet Master
interactions: While you are on Summoner as a main job, interact with the House of the Hero in Windurst Walls (Home Point #1) to speak to Carbuncle.

Return to Bastok and speak with Carmelo with all 3 key items in possesion.

Next: Travel to G-10 in Beaucedine Glacier (at the ice pond) and click on Mirror Pond which only appears during days without snow or clouds. "Gloom" single dark weather with sun is fine.
After the cutscene, return to Bastok and speak to Carmelo to complete quest

quests.title: Lovers in the Dusk
interactions: Speak with Carmelo to begin quest and receive the key item: "Chanson de Liberte"
Next: Travel to H-8 of The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah to locate a ??? (middle of the pos) Survival Guide The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah is the quickest way to get here.

quests.title: Trial-Size Trial by Ice
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak with Castilchat in Northern San d'Oria (E-7) to begin quest and obtain a Mini Tuning Fork of Ice.
Next: You may prepare for the upcoming battle and whenever you are ready, trade Castilchat the tuning fork to be transported to the arena.
You may prepare for the upcoming battle and whenever you are ready, trade Castilchat the tuning fork to be transported to the arena.

name: Cehn Teyohngo
locations: Open Sea Route To Al Zahbi
zones: Open Sea Route To Al Zahbi

quests.title: Chasing Quotas
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Ceraulian inside Cargo Room A to begin this quest. Agree to help obtain a Gold Hairpin From this point on, you can change to any other job to complete the quest.
Next: Trade him a Gold Hairpin for a cutscene. Gold Hairpin +1 will not work
Return to Ceraulian for your reward.

quests.title: Knight Stalker
quests.requirements: Kuftal Coffer Key [Key Item] Challenge to the Royal Knights
interactions: Speak to Ceraulian, Port San d'Oria (I-10) inside Cargo Room A for a cutscene.
Speak to Ceraulian once more after the cutscene.
Although it is not necessarry, you can return to Ceraulian after defeating the NM's for an additional cutscene.

quests.title: The Holy Crest
quests.requirements: Pickaxe Wyvern Egg (provided) [Key Item] Dragon curse remedy (provided)
interactions: Speak to Arminibit and Ceraulian in Port San d'Oria (I-9) inside Cargo Room A.

quests.title: Her Majesty's Garden
interactions: Speak to Chalvatot to begin this quest.
Trade Chalvatot a Derfland Humus to complete the quest. Derfland Humus drops off Doom Scorpions in the Crawlers' Nest. It can also be purchased off the Auction House.

quests.title: In a Pickle
interactions: Speak to Chamama to begin this quest.
Trade a Smooth Stone to Chamama. Smooth Stones drop off Crawlers in East Sarutabaruta and West Sarutabaruta.
Chamama will not always accept the stone you bring to her. If she doesn't, you must get another one and bring it to her. It's possible to have your stone rejected multiple times in a row.

quests.title: Inspector's Gadget!
interactions: Go to Windurst Waters and speak to Chamama at (F-10) (use Home Point #4), who requests four balls of Saruta Cotton to make a Fake moustache.
Give Chamama the four Saruta Cotton, then return to Kohlo-Lakolo for a cut-scene.

quests.title: The Promise
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Chamama, Windurst Waters (F-10).

quests.title: One Good Deed?
interactions: Speak to Chipmy-Popmy to begin this quest.
Return to Chipmy-Popmy.
Return to Chipmy-Popmy for the 3,200 gil and 2,000 Experience Points.

quests.title: Recollections
quests.requirements: Bag of Seeds Whine Cellar Key [Key Item] "Foe Finder Mk. I"
interactions: Begin quest by speaking with Chumimi, found in the basement of Heavens Tower (Windurst). There is an optional cutscene in Ru'Lude Gardens with Laityn (G-9), if you wish to learn more about the story.

After speaking with Chumimi, head to the basement of Crawlers' Nest and obtain a Bag of Seeds drop from either a Fire Elemental or Water Elemental. It is strongly recommended to check with Appollonia in Upper Jeuno (G-6) for weather in Rolanberry Fields as it is shared with Crawlers' Nest as the elementals only appear during weather.
Next: Elementals will pop in the "donut room" on Map 3 with the Strange Apparatus.
Return to Chumimi and trade her the Bag of Seeds.
Return to Chumimi after the cutscene in the Keep, and following another short sequence, the quest is completed and you'll obtain BLM AF1 Feet, Wizard's Sabots.

quests.title: The Root of the Problem
quests.requirements: Silk Cloth [Key Item] "Sluice Surveyor Mk. I"
interactions: Begin quest by speaking with Chumimi as Black Mage in the basement of Heavens Tower. Zoning out of the tower is required after finishing the previous quest.
Return to Chumimi afterwards to recieve the [Key Item] "Sluice Surveyor Mk. I".
Return to Chumimi for the final cutscene and your reward.

quests.title: The Three Magi
interactions: Begin the quest by speaking with Chumimi, found in the basement of Heavens Tower (Windurst). You must be on Black Mage to start this quest.
After speaking with Chumimi, head to any Telepoint and trade a synthesis crystal to receive a Faded Crystal .
Next: Travel to Xarcabard and head toward (E-8)
Take the Glowstone that drops from the NM and return to Chumimi. She will give you the Casting Wand in return.

quests.title: Chips
quests.requirements: Carmine Chip Gray Chip Cyan Chip
interactions: Trade all three chips to Cid in Bastok Metalworks. The chips are no longer Rare, so you may gather several sets before trading to Cid, but since the CCB Polymer Pumps are Rare, you will have to trade them to another character or place them in a delivery box before you are able to get another.

quests.title: Cid's Secret
interactions: Speak to Cid to begin the Quest.
Return to Cid and speak with him to complete the Quest.

quests.title: Dark Legacy
interactions: Speak with Cid's Assistant Raibaht to start quest. After this point, the rest of the quest can be completed on any job.

quests.title: Dark Puppet
interactions: Speak with Cid as a Dark Knight to begin quest. You can be on any job from here on.

quests.title: Shoot First, Ask Questions Later
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speaking with Cid will grant you the [Key Item] Weapon training guide as well as the Gun of Trials .
Trade the Gun of Trials back to Cid. This will give you the [Key Item] Map to the Annals of Truth.
Next: You will be instructed to travel to The Boyahda Tree. Examine the ??? at (J-8) in The Boyahda Tree Map 3.
Go back and speak with Cid to receive your reward.

quests.title: Teak Me to the Stars
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak with Raibaht in Cid's lab to begin quest.

quests.title: The Usual
interactions: Travel to Metalworks and speak with Raibaht at G-8 (Cid's Lab). Make sure you receive a short dialog pertaining to this specific quest and not a cut-scene for one of the multiple quests that involve Raibaht.
Next: Return to the Steaming Sheep restaurant and speak with Hilda to complete quest.

quests.title: Too Many Chefs
interactions: Speak to Ferghus for a cutscene. He can be found in in the Craftsmen's Eatery, south of Cid's workshop. Metalworks HP#1 is the closest.

quests.title: Trust: Bastok
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Clarion Star in Port Bastok HP #1 at (K-7), he will give you the [Key Item] Blue institute card.

Next: Head to Metalworks HP #1 (J-8) and speak to Naji. If this is not your first Trust quest that you are completing, at this point you will be finished with the Quest and receive the [Key Item] Bastok Trust permit.

quests.title: The Quadav's Curse
interactions: Speak to Corann to start the quest (he's inside the northmost house)
Turn in backplate to Corann to complete quest.

quests.title: Enveloped in Darkness
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: After completing The Crimson Trial and attaining level 50+ Red Mage, speak to Curilla (I-9) in Chateau d'Oraguille. You will receive the Old pocket watch. You no longer have to be on RDM after starting the quest.
Next: Players from San d'Oria must be rank 2, but players from other nations must be on at least Bastok / Windurst Mission 2-3 and able the enter Chateau d'Oraguille.
Speak to Curilla again.

On Map 2 at (I-10) examine the ???. A dialog will ask if you want to bury the [Key Item] Old boots and [Key Item] Crawler blood, of course you do. If you get a message "Someone has been digging here" you have forgotten to talk to Curilla after trading the velvet cloth.

quests.title: Old Wounds
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speaking with Curilla will grant you the [Key Item] Weapon training guide as well as the Sapara of Trials . You will need to break the latent on the Sapara of Trials before completing the rest of the Quest.
Trade the Sapara of Trials back to Curilla. This will give you the [Key Item] Map to the Annals of Truth.

Next: You will be instructed to travel to Quicksand Caves. Before you go, you will need to speak to Lokpix in Eastern Altepa Desert at (G-7) and complete the Quest Open Sesame to acquire the [Key Item] Loadstone. This allows you to use the weight-activated switches without needing multiple people.
Go back and speak with Curilla to receive your reward.

quests.title: Peace for the Spirit
interactions: As a Red Mage, Talk to Curilla in Chateau d'Oraguille at (I-9) to start this quest. Note: You don't have to be RDM for the remainder of this quest.

quests.title: The General's Secret
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Curilla and agree to help her to receive [Key Item] Curilla's bottle.
Next: Head to Horlais Peak by going through Yughott Grotto.

Once in Horlais Peak, head to the Hot Springs in the springs and check it to get [Key Item] Curilla's bottle again. To confirm you filled it, because the name doesn't change, observe the text description of the item under "Temporary Items". It should read "The bottle from general Curilla. It is full of water from the hot spring that flows from the Horlais Peak"
Return to Curilla for your reward.

quests.title: Blackmail
quests.requirements: [Key Item] Suspicious envelope Castle Floor Plans
interactions: Speak with Dauperiat to obtain a Suspicious envelope. Deliver this letter to Halver.

Next: Return to Dauperiat, he will now request that you complete a second job for him. If you chose to continue helping Dauperiat you will lose fame. If you agree, he requests that you get the floor plans back from the Orcs.

Return to Dauperiat, he will now request that you complete a second job for him. If you chose to continue helping Dauperiat you will lose fame. If you agree, he requests that you get the floor plans back from the Orcs.
Orcish Serjeants in Fort Ghelsba, Davoi, and Yughott Grotto can drop the plans. Trade the Castle Floor Plans back to Dauperiat for your reward.

quests.title: The Bare Bones
interactions: Speak to Degenhard to begin quest.

quests.title: Escort for Hire (Windurst)
interactions: Speak to Dehn Harzhapan to begin the quest.
Return to Dehn Harzhapan for your reward.

quests.title: The Talekeeper's Gift
interactions: Speak to Deidogg in Bastok Mines.
Speak to Detzo in Bastok Mines (I-6), located in the alleyway around the corner from Deidogg.(Speak to him again if he mentions a Mythril Sallet )
Obtain a Ginger Cookie (sold by the Curio Moogle, or Valeriano in Port Bastok (K-8)) and trade it to Deidogg. The quest will now be flagged.
Next: Travel to Behemoth's Dominion. If you don't have the Survival Guide warp, the quickest way is via Qufim Island; follow the tunnel starting at (G-5) until you zone in.

quests.title: The Talekeeper's Truth
interactions: Talk to Deidogg (H-6) Bastok Mines twice. He is at the bottom of the ramp that leads to the guild.
Return to Bastok and trade the Mottled Quadav Egg to Deidogg. You can speak to Deidogg again for an additional cutscene.
Return to Bastok again and trade the Parasite Skin to Deidogg.
Wait a game day (after clock rolls around past 00:00). Talk to Deidogg for your reward.

interactions: Speak to Deraquien for a cutscene.
Return to Deraquien and speak to him again.
Speak to Deraquien again.
Go back to speak with Deraquien.

interactions: Speak to Detzo to begin quest.
Trade Sallet to Detzo to complete quest and receive your reward. You will also have returned to you the Sallet , so make sure you have space in your inventory!

quests.title: The Talekeeper's Gift
interactions: Speak to Detzo in Bastok Mines (I-6), located in the alleyway around the corner from Deidogg.(Speak to him again if he mentions a Mythril Sallet )

quests.title: The Eleventh's Hour

interactions: Speak to Elki to start quest.

quests.title: Healing the Land
interactions: Speak with Eperdur at (M-7) in Northern San d'Oria. He will give you the [Key Item] Seal of banishing, and you must go place it on a ??? target.
Next: Travel to Gusgen Mines from Konschtat Highlands. The fastest way is to use the Survival Guide → Zulkheim → Gusgen Mines.
Speak with Eperdur again for your reward.

quests.requirements: Fei'Yin Chest Key [Key Item] Fei'Yin magic tome
interactions: Speak to Eperdur in Northern San d'Oria (M-7) second level of the Cathedral.

quests.title: Acting in Good Faith
interactions: Go back to Gantineux. He will provide a [Key Item] Gantineux's letter and tell you to deliver it to Eperdur.
Go to Northern San d'Oria and talk to Eperdur (M-7) upstairs in the Cathedral to complete the quest. Closest to Home Point #2.

quests.title: Past Perfect
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Evi to begin quest.
Speak with Evi again
Return to Evi, speak with him to complete the quest.

quests.title: Distant Loyalties
interactions: Talk to Femitte, who needs a goldsmithing order fulfilled. She requests an Elvaan specifically. She will provide you with a Goldsmithing order.
Travel back to Southern San d'Oria and talk to Femitte to complete the quest.

quests.title: Bait and Switch
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: If you do the incorrect action, either Luto or Miledo will be captured. If so, speak to Ferghus then to Folzen. If the same character gets captured twice, the quest will end.

quests.title: Too Many Chefs
interactions: Speak to Ferghus for a cutscene. He can be found in in the Craftsmen's Eatery, south of Cid's workshop. Metalworks HP#1 is the closest.

quests.title: Trial-Size Trial by Earth
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak with Ferrol at Port Bastok (I-8) to begin quest and obtain a Mini Tuning Fork of Earth.
Next: You may prepare for the upcoming battle and whenever you are ready, trade Ferrol the tuning fork to be transported to the arena.
You may prepare for the upcoming battle and whenever you are ready, trade Ferrol the tuning fork to be transported to the arena.

quests.title: The Brugaire Consortium
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Talk to Fontoumant, who asks you to deliver parcels to various NPCs in Port San d'Oria. You can only hold 1 parcel at a time, so deliver it then return to him for another. Magic Shop Parcel » Regine (J-8)

quests.title: Buckets of Gold
interactions: Start the quest by talking to Foss.

quests.title: Class Reunion
interactions: He will task you to speak to the following three NPCs in any order: Fuepepe at the east Aurastery building in Windurst Waters (North) (L-6).
Fuepepe may need to be spoken to several times, and repeat the same non-quest related text before giving you the correct text to continue the quest.

quests.title: Making the Grade
interactions: Speak to Fuepepe in the east Aurastery in Windurst Waters (North Map) to begin this quest.
Trade the Test Answers to Fuepepe, he will tell you to take them to the principal. Test Answers can sometimes be found on the Auction House, otherwise you have to farm them.
Speak to Fuepepe for your reward.

quests.title: Nothing Matters
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Fuepepe in Windurst Waters North (L-6).

quests.title: Acting in Good Faith
interactions: Speak to Gantineux on the second floor of the Rarab Hostelry (E-10). Closest to Home Point #4.
Gantineux will give you the [Key Item] Spirit incense, and ask you to travel to Eldieme Necropolis.
Next: Head to Eldieme Necropolis and look for a ??? that spawns in one of four locations. (I-7) in Eldieme Necropolis, Map 2: near Batallia Downs (G-7) entrance
Go back to Gantineux. He will provide a [Key Item] Gantineux's letter and tell you to deliver it to Eperdur.

quests.title: Minesweeper
interactions: Gerbaum asks you to exterminate the pests that roam inside Zeruhn Mines.
Trade them to Gerbaum for your reward.

quests.title: Chips
quests.requirements: Carmine Chip Gray Chip Cyan Chip
interactions: Speak to Ghebi Damomohe in Lower Jeuno (I-7) when you are on (or finished with) the mission More Questions than Answers to begin the quest.

quests.title: Tenshodo Membership
interactions: Speak with Ghebi Damomohe. Go to Neptune's Spire in Lower Jeuno and speak with Ghebi Damomohe (I-7) .
Return to Ghebi. Go back to Ghebi Damomohe in Lower Jeuno and complete the membership process.

quests.title: Twinstone Bonding
interactions: Speak with Gioh Ajihri in Windurst Woods at (K-5) to begin the quest. She asks for a Twinstone Earring . The earring can either be found on the AH or you can farm it.

quests.title: A Sentry's Peril
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Talk to Glenne to receive an Ointment.
Next: Zone to West Ronfaure and look for Aaveleon at (G-6).
Return to Glenne and trade her the Ointment Case to complete the quest and to receive your reward.

quests.title: Trust: San d'Oria
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Gondebaud in Southern San d'Oria at (L-6), he will give you the Red institute card.

Next: Head to Northern San d'Oria and speak to Excenmille at (D-9). If this is not your first Trust quest that you are completing, at this point you will be finished with the quest and receive the San d'Oria Trust permit.

quests.title: Vengeful Wrath
interactions: Speak to Goraow (I-6) in the upper stairway of Ore Street to begin quest. Close to Bastok Mines Home Point #3.
Trade a Quadav Helm to Goraow to complete the quest.

quests.title: A Discerning Eye (Bastok)
interactions: Speak to Grin and accept the quest.
Grin will show you a picture of an NPC, you need to memorize.
Several NPCs will spawn on the ship that all look very similar to the one Grin showed you.

quests.title: A Foreman's Best Friend
interactions: Speak to Gudav to begin quest.
After the cutscene, trade Gudav the Dog Collar to complete quest.

quests.title: The Dismayed Customer
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak with Gulemont to begin quest.
When you locate the ???, touch it to obtain [Key Item] Gulemont's document
Next: Return to Gulemon and speak with him to end quest.

quests.title: Trial by Ice
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak with Gulmama to obtain quest. If you are positive that you have the required fame but she is not allowing you to undertake this quest, continue speaking with her until her text changes. Once you have received the key item: Tuning fork of ice, you can now safely undertake the quest.

Next: Travel to Beaucedine Glacier and enter the ruins of Fei'Yin at (J-4). In Fei'Yin (Map A) travel to (G-9) and go down the stairs to the second map. In the basement (Map B) travel to (I-5) to find the entrance to the Cloister of Frost. Preferably, home point to Fei'Yin #2. If you don't have it yet, make sure to grab it on the way.
Return to Gulmama with the whisper and she will provide several reward options including the ability to summon Shiva.

quests.title: Class Reunion
interactions: Speak to Gulmama in Northern San d'Oria at (E-7) to receive an Ice Pendulum .
Next: Head to the Cloister of Frost in Fei'Yin. The closest Home Point is #2. If this is your first time visiting Cloister of Frost, follow these directions:

quests.title: Blade of Darkness
interactions: Speak with Gumbah. He is located on the upper floor in Bastok Mines inside the house at J-7.

quests.title: Blade of Death
interactions: Speak to Gumbah to receive the key item Letter from Zeid.

Next: Use the Chaosbringer to slay 100 more enemies. If you discarded your Chaosbringer , take the boat from Palborough Mines to Zeruhn Mines to receive a new one from Zeid. This will reset the blade, meaning that you will have to kill a total of 200 monsters with the blade in order to complete the quest.

quests.title: Inheritance
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speaking with Gumbah will grant you the key item Weapon training guide as well as the Sword of Trials. You will need to break the latent on the Sword of Trials before completing the rest of the quest. Breaking the Latent
Trade the Sword of Trials back to Gumbah. This will give you the key item Map to the Annals of Truth.
Next: Next, travel to the oasis in Western Altepa Desert at (E-9). It is located in the south west of the map. Via Survival Guide, Unity Warp (125), or Voidwatch warps.
Go back and speak with Gumbah to receive your reward.

quests.title: The Return of the Adventurer
interactions: Speak with Gwill to begin quest.

quests.title: Making Amends
interactions: Speak with Hakkuru-Rinkuru in the Orastery and then trade him an Animal Glue. If you are on The Horutoto Ruins Experiment, you need to complete the mission before you may activate this quest.

quests.title: Wonder Wands
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Hakkuru-Rinkuru (Port Windurst, E-7 Orastery) to begin the quest.
Speak to the War Warlock Captains here in the Orastery. Ohruru is just south of Hakkuru-Rinkuru on the stage.

Trade the Rose Wand , Oak Staff , and Mythril Rod to Hakkuru-Rinkuru for the cutscene that completes the quest. Two of the items will be returned to you at the end of the cutscene along with your reward and new title.

quests.title: A Timely Visit
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Head to Chateau d'Oraguille and speak to Halver. If you just cleared The Voracious Resurgence, you will have to rezone after the cutscene you get and talk to him again.

quests.title: Blackmail
quests.requirements: [Key Item] Suspicious envelope Castle Floor Plans
interactions: Speak with Dauperiat to obtain a Suspicious envelope. Deliver this letter to Halver.

Next: Return to Dauperiat, he will now request that you complete a second job for him. If you chose to continue helping Dauperiat you will lose fame. If you agree, he requests that you get the floor plans back from the Orcs.

quests.title: Fit for a Prince
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Halver for a cutscene. During the cutscene, you are told the description of the type of female Prince Trion is attracted to.
Find a player who matches the description and make a party with them. Then return to Halver while in the same party as the match.
Both players must speak to Halver, and each one will receive the same cutscene. The player who started this quest gains the title of Royal Wedding Planner as well as Castor's Ring.
Next: The player who matches the description will gain the title of Consort Candidate and Pollux's Ring.

quests.title: Black Tiger Skins
interactions: Speak with Hanaa Punaa to begin quest and trade her the 3 hides to end quest.

quests.title: Lizard Skins
interactions: Speak with Hanaa Punaa to begin quest and trade her the 3 skins to complete quest.

quests.title: The Seamstress
interactions: Speak with Hanaa Punaa on the second floor balcony of the Leathercraft guild to start quest and then trade her the 3 skins to complete quest.

quests.title: A Smudge on One's Record
interactions: Talk to Hariga-Origa in Windurst Waters F-8.
Trade both Slime Oil and Frost Turnip at same time to Hariga-Origa your reward.

quests.title: Glyph Hanger
quests.requirements: [Key Item] Note from Hariga-Origa [Key Item] Note from Ipupu
interactions: Speak to Hariga-Origa in Windurst Waters at (F-8).
You will be given the [Key Item] Note from Hariga-Origa, and asked to deliver it to Ipupu. Ipupu is located in West Sarutabaruta (I-8/J-8), near the entrance to Windurst Waters.
She will accept the item and in return give you the [Key Item] Note from Ipupu to deliver to Hariga-Origa.
Next: After delivering the note, you will complete the quest and receive your rewards.

quests.title: A Boy's Dream
quests.requirements: Giant Shell Bug Odontotyrannus [Key Item] Knight's boots
interactions: Talk to Exoroche at Helbort's Blades in Southern San d'Oria (K-7).
Speak with Exoroche at Helbort's Blades in Southern San d'Oria (K-7) one last time.

quests.title: A Purchase of Arms
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Helbort in Southern San d'Oria (K-7) at the weapon shop after completing Father and Son. You will receive [Key Item] Weapons order.
Next: Bring the [Key Item] Weapons order to Alexius in Jugner Forest (I-6) near the lake. You will receive [Key Item] Weapons receipt.
Return to Helbort to complete the quest.

quests.title: Father and Son
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Ailbeche's father, Exoroche, can be found in Southern San d'Oria at (K-7) in Helbort's Blade.

quests.title: Under Oath
quests.requirements: Zvahl Coffer Key [Key Item] Mique's paintbrush [Key Item] Strange sheet of paper
interactions: Speak to Exoroche (K-7) in Helbort's Blades who will tell you how to read the letter.

quests.title: Beadeaux Smog
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to High Bear to begin quest.
Return to High Bear and speak with him to complete the quest.

quests.title: Cid's Secret
interactions: Locate Hilda at (E-6) and speak with her. You can interact with her through the floor if you stand under her (near the bar) while she's upstairs.
Trade the Rolanberry 874 to Hilda and to receive [Key Item] Unfinished letter.
Next: Return to Cid and speak with him to complete the Quest.

quests.title: The Usual
interactions: Speak to Hilda to begin quest.
Trade a King Truffle to Hilda to receive the [Key Item] Steaming Sheep invitation. Can be found via Auction House, in Voidwatch or dropped from some Funguar enemies in Crawlers' Nest.

Next: Travel to Metalworks and speak with Raibaht at G-8 (Cid's Lab). Make sure you receive a short dialog pertaining to this specific quest and not a cut-scene for one of the multiple quests that involve Raibaht.
Return to the Steaming Sheep restaurant and speak with Hilda to complete quest.

quests.title: Synergistic Pursuits
quests.requirements: Earth Crystal Flint Stone Mythril Sand Brass Tank
interactions: Although the original quest has been removed along with its requirements, speaking to Hildolf will still trigger a quest under the same title. This time, he will ask for a vial of Slime Oil. Once you bring him the item, you'll be given the option to choose a Fewell element. He will then craft it for you while explaining the crafting process. After giving you the Fewell of your choosing, he will no longer offer to craft and will instead have a dialogue encouraging you not to give up if you're running low on Fewell.

quests.title: Synergistic Support
interactions: Speak to Hildolf at (F-8) to learn how to create your own Fewell.

quests.title: Crying Over Onions
interactions: Head to southern Windurst Waters (a short walk away, or use Home Point #3) and speak to Honoi-Gomoi - (E-7) for a cut scene. He is upstairs in his house, which is accessed through a back stairway.
Bring the Star Spinel to Honoi-Gomoi, who will reward you with the Star Necklace after a cut scene.
Talk to Kohlo-Lakolo for a cut scene, and then once again back to Honoi-Gomoi for a cut scene to complete the quest.

quests.title: Hat in Hand
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Honoi-Gomoi in the upper portion of Gingerberry Grove (E-7) (South Map).

quests.title: Wild Card
interactions: Speak to Honoi-Gomoi to begin the quest. He is upstairs in his house, which is accessed through a back stairway.
Return to Honoi-Gomoi to complete the quest.

quests.title: Breaking Stones
interactions: Speak with Horatius inside of the Trader's Home at (I-9) in Bastok Markets, who sends you to Dangruf Wadi. The monsters in the area around the ??? are level 90-95. Only the Goblins are aggressive and they can be avoided with just Invisible since they do not have pets.
Head back to Horatius for your reward of 400g.

quests.title: Carbuncle Debacle
quests.requirements: Ltng. Pendulum [Key Item] Daze-breaker charm Wind Pendulum
interactions: Interact with the House of the Hero in Windurst Walls while your job is set to Summoner to begin this quest.

quests.title: Class Reunion
interactions: While your main job is Summoner, interact with the House of the Hero in Windurst Walls for a cutscene with Carbuncle. He will give you a [Key Item] Carbuncle's Tear.

Next: Speak to Koru-Moru in Windurst Walls at (E-7). He will ask for four Astragaloi. Astragalos may be purchased at the Bonecrafting Guild in Windurst Woods from Shih Tayuun, but is only restocked if players NPC it to the guild.

quests.title: I Can Hear a Rainbow
interactions: Go to Windurst Walls (G-3) and examine the door of the House of the Hero for a cutscene.

quests.title: Know One's Onions
interactions: Head to House of the Hero in Windurst Walls (G-3) and try to enter to see a cut-scene.

quests.title: Onion Rings
interactions: Return to Kohlo-Lakolo who will send you to the "House of the Hero" Windurst Walls (G-3) for your reward. If you take too long to return the ring the quest will end when you return to Kohlo-Lakolo and you will not have to go to the "House of the Hero" afterwards. The quest is still considered complete.

quests.title: The Puppet Master
interactions: While you are on Summoner as a main job, interact with the House of the Hero in Windurst Walls (Home Point #1) to speak to Carbuncle.

quests.title: Wild Card
interactions: Head to Windurst Walls (G-3) and check the door at the House of the Hero. Note who you talk to in this cinematic story experience.
If you spoke to Joker during the previous cut-scene, return to to the House of the Hero for your reward.

quests.title: Smoke on the Mountain
interactions: Speak to Hungry Wolf inside the Craftmen's Eatery to start the quest. (Use Home Point #1.)
Trade the Galkan Sausage to Hungry Wolf to complete the quest.

quests.title: Lure of the Wildcat (Windurst)
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak with Ibwam to recieve a [Key Item] Green Sentinel badge and begin the quest.
Return to Ibwam. He will exchange your badge for a [Key Item] Green invitation card.

quests.title: Creepy Crawlies
interactions: Speak to Illu Bohjaa to begin this quest. When prompted, you must reply in the affirmative (Yup!) before the quest will begin for the first time.

Trade Illu Bohjaa either 3x Silk Threads or 3x Crawler Calculus . Silk Threads may be purchased from Meriri (Clothcraft Apprentices or higher only), or Kuzah Hpirohpon at the nearby (Home Point #5) Clothcrafting Guild.

quests.title: The Weight of Your Limits
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speaking with Iron Eater will grant you the key item Weapon training guide as well as the Axe of Trials. You will need to break the latent on the Axe of Trials before completing the rest of the quest. Breaking the Latent

Trade the Axe of Trials back to Iron Eater. This will give you the key item Map to the Annals of Truth. You will be instructed to travel to The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah. To spawn the NM, use the Survival Guide to zone in The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah and head to the northwest corner of (F-6) to find the ???.
Next: Alternatively, for the fastest route, use the Unity Warp to Ro'Maeve (level 125), then zone into The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah. The ??? is located at (F-5) in the southwest area.
Go back and speak with Iron Eater to receive your reward.

quests.title: The Gustaberg Tour
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Izabele to begin quest

quests.title: Wondering Minstrel
interactions: In Windurst Waters (North), go into the Timbre Timbers tavern (F-10) and speak to Yuli Yaam, Yung Yaam, then Jatan-Paratan. Respond with "I have no recollection at all" to continue, then speak with him again. The quest will now appear in your quest log.
Trade a piece of Rosewood Lumber to Jatan-Paratan for your reward.

quests.title: The Rivalry/The Competition
interactions: The quest begins from either Joulet (for 'The Competition') or Gallijaux (for 'The Rivalry').

quests.title: Trial by Earth
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak with Juroro to obtain the quest. If you are positive that you have the required fame but she is not allowing you to undertake this quest, continue speaking with her until her text changes. Once you have received the [Key Item] Tuning fork of earth, you can now safely undertake the quest.

Next: Travel to Eastern Altepa Desert and look for the entrance to Quicksand Caves at (J-7) (where the level 30+ beetle/antica camp is). This will put you at the first map of Quicksand Caves at (L-4). You will need to travel to (E-10) of the map, to find a hidden entrance to the Cloister of Tremors. The map to the right hand side shows you the map with the hidden tunnels, falls and other traps. Be careful to not fall into the wrong areas. Preferably, home point to Quicksand Caves #2. If you don't have it yet, make sure to grab it on the way.
Return to Juroro with the whisper and she will provide several reward options including the ability to summon Titan.

quests.title: The Puppet Master
interactions: Speak to Juroro in Port Bastok at (I-8) (Home Point #1). Ildy-Goldy will give you an Earth Pendulum .
Next: Make your way through the Quicksand Caves to the Cloister of Tremors. Home Point #2 is at the entrance. If this is your first time visiting Cloister of Tremors, follow these directions:
Speak to Juroro again.

quests.title: Ayame and Kaede
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Talk to Kaede in Port Bastok at (J-5) - nearest to Home Point #1 (E) - in the north most house for a cutscene. (if she says "I heard somebody at the warehouse saying that the people from Aht Urhgan are sneaky.", disregard it and talk to her again.)
Return to Kaede's house and speak with Ensetsu at (I-5) for a cutscene. The quest log entry will appear after this cutscene.

quests.title: Food for Thought
quests.requirements: Grilled Hare Hard-boiled Egg Pamtam Kelp Tortilla Windurstian Tea
interactions: Speak to Ohbiru-Dohbiru & Kenapa-Keppa again to get their food orders.
Trade Kenapa-Keppa a Hard-boiled Egg.

quests.title: Hat in Hand
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Kenapa-Keppa inside the most southern door of the Rhinostery (South Map).

quests.title: Overnight Delivery
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Kenapa-Keppa after 7:00 Vana'diel time. You need to speak to him four times to officially begin the quest.
Return to Kenapa-Keppa before 6:00 to complete the quest.

quests.title: Say It with Flowers
interactions: (Optional) Talk to Kenapa-Keppa.

quests.title: Blue Ribbon Blues
interactions: Give the Purple Ribbon to Kerutoto (J-8) Windurst Waters South (northern Rhinostery building). You will receive 3,600 gil.
Next: You must wait one Earth minute before you talk to Kerutoto again, she will give you back the item.
You must wait one Earth minute before you talk to Kerutoto again, she will give you back the item.

Next: Go to The Eldieme Necropolis from the (J-10) entrance in Batallia Downs. If you have unlocked it before, the Survival Guide teleport will take you there. You will need a [Key Item] Magicked astrolabe or a friend to help hit switches to open doors.
Check the Hume Bones again after NM is defeated to receive Blue Ribbon . You can return to Kerutoto and complete the quest.

quests.title: Food for Thought
quests.requirements: Grilled Hare Hard-boiled Egg Pamtam Kelp Tortilla Windurstian Tea
interactions: Before starting, check if Kerutoto keeps asking about challenging Diabolos. If she does, you will have to accept the quest. Once you accepted it and have Waking Dreams in your Quest Log, you'll be able to start Food for Thought. To receive this quest, you will have to talk to the following NPCs in this exact order:
Next: Speak to Ohbiru-Dohbiru in the southern Rhinostery building at (J-9). He will mention that he's hungry.
Head to the northern Rhinostery building and speak to Kerutoto. The quest will be added to your Quest Log.
Trade Kerutoto a Grilled Hare.

Speak again with Kerutoto to finish the quest. (!UPDATE!) No need to speak with Kerutoto. The quest will be automatically completed once you trade the final orders. Each item traded to the NPCs nets you a portion of the 1,000 Gil reward.

quests.title: Waking Dreams
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Kerutoto, Windurst Waters South (J-8) HP #3, for a cutscene that begins the quest and key item Vial of dream incense. Windurst Waters Home Point #3 is just south of Kerutoto.
Return to Kerutoto with the whisper and she will provide several reward options including the ability to summon Diabolos.

quests.title: Babban Ny Mheillea
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: The quest begins after speaking to Khoto Rokkorah and receiving a cutscene.
Return to Khoto Rokkorah to receive the final cutscene and reward.

quests.title: Crying Over Onions
interactions: Talk to Kohlo-Lakolo for a cut scene to start the quest.
Talk to Kohlo-Lakolo for a cut scene, and then once again back to Honoi-Gomoi for a cut scene to complete the quest.

quests.title: Inspector's Gadget!
interactions: Speak to Kohlo-Lakolo for a cut-scene, then to Pichichi near him, who directs you to her mother.
Give Chamama the four Saruta Cotton, then return to Kohlo-Lakolo for a cut-scene.

quests.title: Know One's Onions
interactions: Speak to Kohlo-Lakolo Port Windurst behind the warehouse at (G-5).
Return to Kohlo-Lakolo and speak with him to complete the quest and receive your reward.

quests.title: Onion Rings
interactions: Speak to Kohlo-Lakolo for a storytelling sequence to begin this quest. If you already have the Old ring, you'll skip ahead to the final cut scene.

Return to Kohlo-Lakolo who will send you to the "House of the Hero" Windurst Walls (G-3) for your reward. If you take too long to return the ring the quest will end when you return to Kohlo-Lakolo and you will not have to go to the "House of the Hero" afterwards. The quest is still considered complete.
Zone and return to Kohlo-Lakolo to receive your reward.

quests.title: The Promise
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Kohlo-Lakolo to begin this quest.
Return to Kohlo-Lakolo for your reward.
Zoning and talking to Kohlo-Lakolo again with this key item will give a final, concluding cutscene.

quests.title: Truth, Justice, and the Onion Way!
interactions: Talk to Kohlo-Lakolo behind warehouse #1 at G-5 in Port Windurst for a cut-scene.

quests.title: Wild Card
interactions: Speak to Kohlo-Lakolo, Port Windurst (G-5).

quests.title: Know One's Onions
interactions: Speak to Kohlo-Lakolo Port Windurst behind the warehouse at (G-5).

quests.title: Legendary Plan B
quests.requirements: Luminicloth Revival Tree Root Wolf Hide
interactions: Speak to Kopuro-Popuro to begin this quest.
Trade Kopuro-Popuro a Luminicloth , Revival Tree Root , and a Wolf Hide for your reward. All these items can be found on the Auction House.

quests.title: The All-New C-2000
quests.requirements: Rabbit Hide Two-Leaf Mandragora Bud Insect Wing
interactions: Speak to Kopuro-Popuro to begin this quest.

Trade Kopuro-Popuro a Two-Leaf Mandragora Bud , Insect Wing , and a Rabbit Hide to complete the quest. The Two-Leaf Mandragora Bud is EX and can be found by killing most mandragora type mobs, including Tiny Mandragoras in East Sarutabaruta and West Sarutabaruta.

quests.title: The All-New C-3000
interactions: Speak to Kopuro-Popuro to begin this quest.
Trade Kopuro-Popuro a Beetle Shell and a Hecteyes Eye to complete the quest.

quests.title: A Greeting Cardian
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Talk to Kororo in the Manustery at (H-9) in Windurst Woods.
Talk to the Cardian that Kororo mentions. Choose any of the greetings, it doesn't matter what choice you make.
Leave Windurst Woods, then return after one earth minute and talk to Kororo again.
Return to Kororo to receive your reward.

Return to Zon-Fobun to complete quest.

quests.title: Pretty Little Things
interactions: Travel to Port Jeuno (E-8) and find Zona Shodhun , the Mithra who explains gardening.
Speak with Zona Shodhun to begin Pretty Little Things . Her dialogue hints that she wants something pretty but does not plainly name it.
Trade one Yellow Rock to Zona Shodhun. The trade completes the quest and displays the message that you have learned your way through Jeuno’s back alleys.
